discoveries.name: Industrial Catalyst Design
discoveries.mechanism: Relate a catalyst's composition and accessible structure to a declared process reaction
discoveries.operating_requirement: Qualified materials, characterization and representative process trials
discoveries.consequence: Improve selected process rates or selectivity while poisoning and regeneration costs remain

discoveries.name: Polymer-Chain Models
discoveries.mechanism: Relate macromolecular structure to observed material behavior
discoveries.operating_requirement: Characterized substances, qualified measurements and explicit models
discoveries.consequence: Explain selected processing and mechanical properties without assuming all polymers behave alike

discoveries.name: Thermoplastic Processing
discoveries.mechanism: Shape qualified polymers through reversible softening and cooling within their process window
discoveries.operating_requirement: Suitable resin, shaping equipment, energy and temperature control
discoveries.consequence: Produce repeatable shapes while thermal history and contamination affect quality

discoveries.name: Polymer Molecular-Weight Control
discoveries.mechanism: Characterize and control the distribution of polymer chain sizes
discoveries.operating_requirement: Qualified chemistry, measurement instruments and process control
discoveries.consequence: Tune selected processing and strength properties while distributions remain finite

discoveries.name: Polymer-Additive Formulation
discoveries.mechanism: Assess modifiers against declared material properties and exposure conditions
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible additives, mixing, tests and traceable formulations
discoveries.consequence: Change processing or durability while introducing migration and recycling tradeoffs

discoveries.name: Polymer Monomer Purification
discoveries.mechanism: Qualify feed monomers by separating and measuring process-relevant impurities
discoveries.operating_requirement: Suitable feedstock, separation plant, analytical staff and storage
discoveries.consequence: Supply defined polymer feedstock without granting a synthesis process

discoveries.name: Radical Chain Polymerization
discoveries.mechanism: Build polymer chains through controlled radical propagation with evaluated product properties
discoveries.operating_requirement: Qualified monomers, controlled reactor, process chemicals and characterization
discoveries.consequence: Produce specified polymer material with conversion and distribution limits

discoveries.name: Ionic Chain Polymerization
discoveries.mechanism: Build polymer chains through qualified ionic active centers under controlled conditions
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible feedstock, controlled plant and analytical qualification
discoveries.consequence: Produce selected polymer structures while impurity sensitivity and process limits remain

discoveries.name: Coordination Polymerization
discoveries.mechanism: Use a qualified coordination catalyst system to control chain growth and selected structure
discoveries.operating_requirement: Suitable monomers, catalyst supply, industrial reactor and product testing
discoveries.consequence: Produce evaluated polymer structures with catalyst and feedstock dependence

discoveries.name: Condensative Step Polymerization
discoveries.mechanism: Join functional molecules through qualified step reactions that release small-molecule products
discoveries.operating_requirement: Suitable reactants, controlled reactor, separation and molecular characterization
discoveries.consequence: Produce specified polymer material with stoichiometry and removal limits

discoveries.name: Additive Step Polymerization
discoveries.mechanism: Join functional molecules through qualified step reactions without a required small-molecule elimination
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible reactants, controlled plant and product characterization
discoveries.consequence: Produce evaluated polymer networks or chains without conflating all addition with chain propagation

discoveries.name: Ring Opening Polymerization
discoveries.mechanism: Convert suitable cyclic monomers into a qualified polymer through ring-opening reactions
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible monomers, controlled reactor and analytical qualification
discoveries.consequence: Produce selected chain structures within process and purity limits

discoveries.name: Copolymer Sequence Control
discoveries.mechanism: Control and characterize incorporation of different monomer units within a specified copolymer
discoveries.operating_requirement: Qualified feeds, suitable synthesis route and sequence-sensitive evidence
discoveries.consequence: Tune selected properties while composition alone does not establish sequence

discoveries.name: Polymer Tacticity Characterization
discoveries.mechanism: Measure stereochemical ordering in a qualified polymer against a defined analytical method
discoveries.operating_requirement: Representative material, appropriate instrumentation and trained interpretation
discoveries.consequence: Relate evaluated chain ordering to properties without treating one metric as complete quality

discoveries.name: Polymer Reaction Heat Management
discoveries.mechanism: Measure and control heat release and removal in a qualified polymer production process
discoveries.operating_requirement: Suitable reactor, actual cooling capacity, instruments and trained operators
discoveries.consequence: Operate within evaluated thermal limits rather than scaling batch volume without heat transfer

discoveries.name: Polymer Solution Processing
discoveries.mechanism: Form and recover qualified polymer material through controlled dissolution and solvent handling
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible polymer, solvent, process plant and recovery or disposal capacity
discoveries.consequence: Produce selected material forms with solvent and energy costs

discoveries.name: Polymer Melt Rheology
discoveries.mechanism: Measure flow response of a polymer melt under defined thermal and deformation conditions
discoveries.operating_requirement: Representative polymer, qualified rheometry and thermal control
discoveries.consequence: Inform forming conditions while material degradation and history remain relevant

discoveries.name: Polymer Injection Molding
discoveries.mechanism: Fill a qualified mold with controlled polymer flow and solidification
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible polymer, molding machine, tooling, power and operators
discoveries.consequence: Produce repeatable parts within mold, shrinkage and cycle limits

discoveries.name: Polymer Blow Molding
discoveries.mechanism: Expand a qualified polymer preform against a mold through controlled pressure
discoveries.operating_requirement: Suitable preforms or melt, tooling, air service and process control
discoveries.consequence: Produce selected hollow parts while wall distribution and defects constrain use

discoveries.name: Polymer Film Extrusion
discoveries.mechanism: Form a continuous qualified polymer film through controlled die flow and cooling
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible polymer, extrusion equipment, cooling and inspection
discoveries.consequence: Produce finite film stock with thickness and orientation limits

discoveries.name: Polymer Thermoforming
discoveries.mechanism: Shape a heated qualified polymer sheet against compatible tooling
discoveries.operating_requirement: Suitable sheets, heating, pressure or vacuum service and molds
discoveries.consequence: Form selected parts while thinning and temperature limits remain

discoveries.name: Polymer Foam Cell Control
discoveries.mechanism: Control and measure cell structure in a qualified expanded polymer material
discoveries.operating_requirement: Compatible formulation, process plant and density or mechanical testing
discoveries.consequence: Produce selected lightweight material with strength, aging and waste tradeoffs

discoveries.name: Polymer Weathering Trials
discoveries.mechanism: Measure property changes under specified light, moisture and temperature exposure
discoveries.operating_requirement: Representative samples, qualified exposure and property tests
discoveries.consequence: Bound outdoor service claims without equating short tests with indefinite lifetime

discoveries.name: Polymer Solvent Recovery
discoveries.mechanism: Recover suitable solvent from a characterized polymer-process stream
discoveries.operating_requirement: Separation plant, energy, quality controls and residue handling
discoveries.consequence: Reduce selected make-up solvent needs with finite recovery yield

discoveries.name: Selective Polymer Depolymerization
discoveries.mechanism: Deconstruct a specified polymer into qualified recoverable intermediates through a selected process
discoveries.operating_requirement: Sorted feedstock, suitable plant, process inputs and purification
discoveries.consequence: Recover selected chemical value without assuming mixed plastics all return to pristine monomers
